WITH needles AS (
  SELECT event_uid, time, 'api' AS source, service || '/' || api_operation AS detail
    FROM f_api     WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT event_uid, time, 'process', image_name || ' :: ' || COALESCE(cmd_line, '')
    FROM f_process WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT event_uid, time, 'dns', query_hostname
    FROM f_dns     WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT event_uid, time, 'network', dst_ip || ':' || CAST(dst_port AS VARCHAR)
    FROM f_network WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT event_uid, time, 'auth', 'remote-auth ' || outcome
    FROM f_auth    WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN event_uid = 'api-needle-0'                                              THEN 'OAuth consent'
      WHEN event_uid IN ('proc-needle-1', 'proc-needle-late')                      THEN 'PowerShell execution'
      WHEN event_uid = 'dns-needle-c2' OR event_uid LIKE 'conn-needle-beacon%'     THEN 'C2 beacon'
      WHEN event_uid LIKE 'auth-needle-lateral%' OR event_uid LIKE 'conn-needle-lateral%' THEN 'Lateral connection'
      WHEN event_uid = 'api-needle-nomfa'                                          THEN 'No-MFA privilege escalation'
      WHEN event_uid = 'api-needle-assumerole'                                     THEN 'Role assumption'
      WHEN event_uid LIKE 'api-needle-exfil%'                                      THEN 'Data exfiltration'
    END AS stage
  FROM needles
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MIN(time))      AS step,
  stage,
  to_timestamp(MIN(time) / 1000)             AS stage_start,
  COUNT(*)                                    AS event_count
FROM classified
WHERE stage IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY stage
ORDER BY MIN(time);

-- Reconstruct the kill chain from the planted "needle" events (event_uid LIKE '%needle%').
-- Attacker thread: user jdoe / src 203.0.113.7 / host WS1 (10.10.1.21). All other rows are background noise.
-- Each requested stage is labeled and the result is ordered by first-seen time.
-- NOTE: the question lists 7 stages, but the store contains NO OAuth-consent event
--       (no oauth/consent marker in any table), so that stage cannot be reconstructed;
--       the six logged stages plus supporting initial-access/recon/session needles are returned in order.
WITH needles AS (
  SELECT event_uid, time, 'f_api'     AS src, api_operation AS op, resource AS detail
    FROM f_api     WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
  UNION ALL SELECT event_uid, time, 'f_process', image_name, cmd_line
    FROM f_process WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
  UNION ALL SELECT event_uid, time, 'f_dns', query_hostname, answer
    FROM f_dns     WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
  UNION ALL SELECT event_uid, time, 'f_network', protocol_name, dst_ip || ':' || CAST(dst_port AS VARCHAR)
    FROM f_network WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
  UNION ALL SELECT event_uid, time, 'f_auth', outcome, target_host
    FROM f_auth    WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
  UNION ALL SELECT event_uid, time, 'f_session', host, NULL
    FROM f_session WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
),
labeled AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN event_uid = 'api-needle-0'                               THEN '1. Initial access (stolen session token)'
      WHEN event_uid LIKE 'proc-needle-1%' OR op = 'powershell.exe' THEN '2. PowerShell execution'
      WHEN event_uid = 'dns-needle-c2' OR event_uid LIKE 'conn-needle-beacon%' THEN '3. C2 beacon'
      WHEN event_uid = 'proc-needle-late'                          THEN '4. Local recon (whoami /all)'
      WHEN event_uid LIKE '%needle-lateral%'                       THEN '5. Lateral connection (WS1 -> WS2 RDP)'
      WHEN event_uid = 'api-needle-nomfa'                          THEN '6. No-MFA privilege escalation'
      WHEN event_uid = 'api-needle-assumerole'                     THEN '7. Role assumption (AssumeRole)'
      WHEN event_uid LIKE 'api-needle-exfil%'                      THEN '8. Data exfiltration (S3 GetObject)'
      WHEN event_uid = 'sess-needle-ws1'                           THEN '9. Session marker (WS1)'
      ELSE event_uid
    END AS attack_stage
  FROM needles
)
SELECT
  attack_stage,
  count(*)                     AS event_count,
  arg_min(op, time)            AS first_operation,
  arg_min(detail, time)        AS first_detail,
  to_timestamp(min(time)/1000) AS first_seen_utc,
  to_timestamp(max(time)/1000) AS last_seen_utc
FROM labeled
GROUP BY attack_stage
ORDER BY min(time);

WITH stages AS (
  SELECT 'OAuth consent (sts:GetSessionToken)' AS stage, time, event_uid::VARCHAR AS detail
    FROM f_api WHERE event_uid = 'api-needle-0'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'PowerShell execution', time, image_name FROM f_process WHERE event_uid = 'proc-needle-1'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'C2 beacon', min(time), 'cdn-telemetry-sync.net -> 203.0.113.66; '||count(*)||' beacon events'
    FROM (
      SELECT time FROM f_dns WHERE event_uid = 'dns-needle-c2'
      UNION ALL SELECT time FROM f_network WHERE event_uid LIKE 'conn-needle-beacon-%'
    )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Lateral connection', time, 'jdoe -> '||target_host FROM f_auth WHERE event_uid = 'auth-needle-lateral'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'No-MFA privilege escalation (iam:AttachUserPolicy)', time, 'mfa_present='||mfa_present::VARCHAR
    FROM f_api WHERE event_uid = 'api-needle-nomfa'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Role assumption (sts:AssumeRole)', time, actor_user_uid FROM f_api WHERE event_uid = 'api-needle-assumerole'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Data exfiltration (s3:GetObject)', min(time), 'acme-financials-prod/q3; '||count(*)||' objects'
    FROM f_api WHERE event_uid LIKE 'api-needle-exfil-%'
)
SELECT stage, time AS stage_time_ms, to_timestamp(time/1000) AS stage_time_utc, detail
FROM stages ORDER BY time;

WITH needle AS (
  SELECT 'api'     AS tbl, event_uid, time FROM f_api     WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'process', event_uid, time FROM f_process WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'dns',     event_uid, time FROM f_dns     WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'network', event_uid, time FROM f_network WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'auth',    event_uid, time FROM f_auth    WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
  UNION ALL SELECT 'session', event_uid, time FROM f_session WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
),
tagged AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN event_uid = 'api-needle-0'            THEN 'OAuth consent (token grant: sts:GetSessionToken, no MFA)'
      WHEN event_uid LIKE 'proc-needle-1%'       THEN 'PowerShell execution (winword.exe -> powershell -EncodedCommand)'
      WHEN event_uid = 'dns-needle-c2'
        OR event_uid LIKE 'conn-needle-beacon%'  THEN 'C2 beacon (DNS cdn-telemetry-sync.net + periodic outbound to 203.0.113.66)'
      WHEN event_uid LIKE '%needle-lateral%'     THEN 'Lateral connection (RDP 3389 WS1->WS2, remote auth jdoe)'
      WHEN event_uid = 'api-needle-nomfa'        THEN 'No-MFA privilege escalation (iam:AttachUserPolicy, mfa_present=false)'
      WHEN event_uid = 'api-needle-assumerole'   THEN 'Role assumption (sts:AssumeRole AdminRole)'
      WHEN event_uid LIKE 'api-needle-exfil%'    THEN 'Data exfiltration (s3:GetObject acme-financials-prod/q3/*)'
      WHEN event_uid LIKE 'proc-needle-late%'    THEN 'Post-lateral recon (cmd.exe whoami /all on WS1)'
      ELSE 'other-needle: ' || event_uid
    END AS stage
  FROM needle
),
per_stage AS (
  SELECT stage,
         min(time) AS stage_start,
         max(time) AS stage_end,
         count(*)  AS event_count,
         arg_min(event_uid, time) AS first_event_uid
  FROM tagged
  GROUP BY stage
)
SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY stage_start) AS stage_seq,
       stage,
       to_timestamp(stage_start / 1000) AS first_seen_utc,
       to_timestamp(stage_end   / 1000) AS last_seen_utc,
       event_count,
       first_event_uid
FROM per_stage
ORDER BY stage_start;

WITH stages AS (
  -- OAuth consent  -> closest analog in this AWS/OCSF store: STS GetSessionToken (token/consent grant)
  SELECT 'OAuth consent' AS stage, min(time) AS first_seen, count(*) AS n
    FROM f_api WHERE service = 'sts' AND api_operation = 'GetSessionToken'
  UNION ALL
  -- PowerShell execution (OCSF Process Activity 1007)
  SELECT 'PowerShell execution', min(time), count(*)
    FROM f_process WHERE image_name = 'powershell.exe'
  UNION ALL
  -- C2 beacon -> DNS resolving into the external 93.184.0.0/16 C2 block
  SELECT 'C2 beacon', min(time), count(*)
    FROM f_dns WHERE answer LIKE '93.184.%'
  UNION ALL
  -- lateral connection -> internal-to-internal admin-protocol connection (RDP/SSH/SMB/WinRM)
  SELECT 'lateral connection', min(time), count(*)
    FROM f_network WHERE dst_ip LIKE '10.%' AND dst_port IN (3389, 22, 445, 5985)
  UNION ALL
  -- no-MFA privilege escalation -> IAM privilege grant without MFA
  SELECT 'no-MFA privilege escalation', min(time), count(*)
    FROM f_api WHERE service = 'iam' AND api_operation IN ('AttachUserPolicy', 'CreatePolicyVersion')
             AND (mfa_present = false OR mfa_value = false)
  UNION ALL
  -- role assumption (STS AssumeRole)
  SELECT 'role assumption', min(time), count(*)
    FROM f_api WHERE service = 'sts' AND api_operation = 'AssumeRole'
  UNION ALL
  -- data exfiltration -> S3 object access/staging
  SELECT 'data exfiltration', min(time), count(*)
    FROM f_api WHERE service = 's3' AND api_operation IN ('GetObject', 'PutObject')
)
SELECT stage,
       first_seen,
       to_timestamp(first_seen / 1000) AS first_seen_utc,
       n AS matching_events
FROM stages
ORDER BY first_seen;

-- Kill-chain reconstruction from the planted "needle" events (event_uid LIKE '%needle%'),
-- collapsing the multi-event stages (C2 beacons, S3 exfil burst) into one stage row each,
-- ordered by first occurrence time. The store has no literal OAuth-consent record; the
-- earliest needle (api-needle-0 = sts:GetSessionToken) is the initial-access entry point.
WITH needles AS (
    SELECT event_uid, time, 'f_api' AS source, service || '/' || api_operation AS detail
    FROM f_api      WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT event_uid, time, 'f_process', image_name || ' ' || COALESCE(cmd_line,'')
    FROM f_process  WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT event_uid, time, 'f_dns', 'dns:' || query_hostname
    FROM f_dns      WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT event_uid, time, 'f_network', src_ip || '->' || dst_ip || ':' || dst_port
    FROM f_network  WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT event_uid, time, 'f_auth', 'auth:' || outcome
    FROM f_auth     WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT event_uid, time, 'f_session', 'session:' || host
    FROM f_session  WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%'
),
staged AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN event_uid = 'api-needle-0'            THEN '1. OAuth consent / initial access (sts:GetSessionToken)'
            WHEN event_uid LIKE 'proc-needle-1%'       THEN '2. PowerShell execution'
            WHEN event_uid LIKE 'dns-needle-c2%'
              OR event_uid LIKE 'conn-needle-beacon%'  THEN '3. C2 beacon'
            WHEN event_uid LIKE '%lateral%'            THEN '4. Lateral connection'
            WHEN event_uid = 'api-needle-nomfa'        THEN '5. No-MFA privilege escalation'
            WHEN event_uid LIKE '%assumerole%'         THEN '6. Role assumption'
            WHEN event_uid LIKE '%exfil%'              THEN '7. Data exfiltration'
            ELSE '9. other (' || event_uid || ')'
        END AS stage,
        time, source, detail
    FROM needles
)
SELECT
    stage,
    count(*)                          AS event_count,
    min(time)                         AS first_time_ms,
    to_timestamp(min(time)/1000)      AS first_ts,
    to_timestamp(max(time)/1000)      AS last_ts,
    any_value(source)                 AS source_table,
    min(detail)                       AS example_detail
FROM staged
GROUP BY stage
ORDER BY first_time_ms

-- Kill-chain reconstruction over the OCSF fidelity store.
-- The attacker thread is tagged with '%needle%' event_uids; the noisy background
-- population is excluded. One row per stage, ordered by time. Repeated beacon and
-- exfil series are collapsed to their first/aggregate representative.
-- NOTE: the question presumes an OAuth-consent stage, but NO oauth/consent event
-- exists in the store, so that branch contributes zero rows (honest: absent).
WITH needle AS (
  -- OAuth consent: searched for but not present in the store (returns 0 rows)
  SELECT 'OAuth consent' AS stage,
         service || ' ' || api_operation AS detail,
         time, src_ip
  FROM f_api
  WHERE event_uid ILIKE '%oauth%' OR event_uid ILIKE '%consent%'
     OR api_operation ILIKE '%consent%' OR api_operation ILIKE '%oauth%'

  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'PowerShell execution', image_name || ' ' || COALESCE(cmd_line,''),
         time, NULL
  FROM f_process
  WHERE event_uid = 'proc-needle-1'

  UNION ALL  -- C2 beacon: the malicious-domain DNS resolution
  SELECT 'C2 beacon (DNS resolve)', 'query ' || query_hostname || ' -> ' || COALESCE(answer,''),
         time, src_ip
  FROM f_dns
  WHERE event_uid = 'dns-needle-c2'

  UNION ALL  -- C2 beacon: first of the repeating 443 beacon connections
  SELECT 'C2 beacon (network)',
         src_hostname || '->' || dst_ip || ':' || dst_port || ' ' || COALESCE(protocol_name,''),
         time, src_ip
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM f_network
    WHERE event_uid ILIKE 'conn-needle-beacon%'
    ORDER BY time
    LIMIT 1
  )

  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Lateral connection',
         src_hostname || '->' || dst_ip || ':' || dst_port || ' (RDP) ' || COALESCE(protocol_name,''),
         time, src_ip
  FROM f_network
  WHERE event_uid = 'conn-needle-lateral'

  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'No-MFA privilege escalation',
         service || ' ' || api_operation || ' mfa_present=' || mfa_present,
         time, src_ip
  FROM f_api
  WHERE event_uid = 'api-needle-nomfa'

  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Role assumption', service || ' ' || api_operation, time, src_ip
  FROM f_api
  WHERE event_uid = 'api-needle-assumerole'

  UNION ALL  -- Data exfiltration: collapse the repeating s3 GetObject series
  SELECT 'Data exfiltration',
         service || ' ' || api_operation || ' (x' || count(*) || ' objects)',
         min(time), min(src_ip)
  FROM f_api
  WHERE event_uid ILIKE 'api-needle-exfil%'
  GROUP BY service, api_operation
)
SELECT
  row_number() OVER (ORDER BY time) AS step,
  stage,
  detail,
  to_timestamp(time / 1000) AS event_ts,
  src_ip
FROM needle
ORDER BY time;

WITH actor(uid) AS (

         ('S-1-5-21-3623811015-3361044348-30300820-1107')
),
refs AS (  -- every hostname/ip/instance-id the human actor's events point at

  UNION SELECT src_ip          FROM f_auth    WHERE user_uid       IN (SELECT uid FROM actor)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.ip) AS distinct_physical_assets  -- IP is the shared key that collapses hostname/instance aliases
FROM refs r

  ON r.ref = a.hostname OR r.ref = a.ip OR r.ref = a.instance_uid

WITH RECURSIVE
hu_user AS (
  SELECT unnest([
    'jdoe@acme.example',
    'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/jdoe',
    'arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/AdminRole/jdoe-session',
    'S-1-5-21-3623811015-3361044348-30300820-1107']) AS uid
),
direct_tok AS (
  SELECT target_host AS x FROM f_auth     WHERE user_uid       IN (SELECT uid FROM hu_user)
  UNION SELECT src_ip          FROM f_auth     WHERE user_uid       IN (SELECT uid FROM hu_user)
  UNION SELECT host            FROM f_session  WHERE user_uid       IN (SELECT uid FROM hu_user)
  UNION SELECT device_hostname FROM f_process  WHERE actor_user_uid IN (SELECT uid FROM hu_user)
  UNION SELECT src_ip          FROM f_api      WHERE actor_user_uid IN (SELECT uid FROM hu_user)
),
net_alias AS (
  SELECT src_hostname AS x FROM f_network WHERE src_ip IN (SELECT x FROM direct_tok WHERE x IS NOT NULL)
  UNION SELECT src_hostname FROM f_dns      WHERE src_ip IN (SELECT x FROM direct_tok WHERE x IS NOT NULL)
),
seed AS (SELECT DISTINCT x FROM (SELECT x FROM direct_tok UNION SELECT x FROM net_alias) WHERE x IS NOT NULL),
edges AS (
  SELECT hostname AS a, ip AS b FROM f_asset
  UNION SELECT hostname, instance_uid FROM f_asset
  UNION SELECT ip,       instance_uid FROM f_asset
  UNION SELECT ip,       hostname     FROM f_asset
  UNION SELECT instance_uid, hostname FROM f_asset
  UNION SELECT instance_uid, ip       FROM f_asset
  UNION SELECT src_hostname, src_ip FROM f_network
  UNION SELECT src_ip, src_hostname FROM f_network
  UNION SELECT src_hostname, src_ip FROM f_dns
  UNION SELECT src_ip, src_hostname FROM f_dns
),
reach(node) AS (
  SELECT x FROM seed
  UNION
  SELECT e.b FROM edges e JOIN reach r ON e.a = r.node WHERE e.b IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fa.ip) AS distinct_physical_assets
FROM f_asset fa
WHERE fa.hostname     IN (SELECT node FROM reach)
   OR fa.ip           IN (SELECT node FROM reach)
   OR fa.instance_uid IN (SELECT node FROM reach);

WITH RECURSIVE
needle_hosts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT target_host AS h FROM f_auth   WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%' AND target_host IS NOT NULL
  UNION SELECT DISTINCT host            FROM f_session WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%' AND host IS NOT NULL
  UNION SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname FROM f_process WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%' AND device_hostname IS NOT NULL
  UNION SELECT DISTINCT src_hostname    FROM f_network WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%' AND src_hostname IS NOT NULL
  UNION SELECT DISTINCT src_hostname    FROM f_dns     WHERE event_uid LIKE '%needle%' AND src_hostname IS NOT NULL
),
edges AS (
  SELECT a.hostname AS x, b.hostname AS y
  FROM f_asset a JOIN f_asset b
    ON a.ip = b.ip OR a.instance_uid = b.instance_uid OR a.hostname = b.hostname
),
lp(node, label) AS (
  SELECT hostname, hostname FROM f_asset
  UNION
  SELECT e.x, l.label FROM lp l JOIN edges e ON e.y = l.node
),
comp AS (SELECT node AS hostname, MIN(label) AS component FROM lp GROUP BY node)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.component) AS distinct_physical_assets
FROM needle_hosts n
JOIN comp c ON c.hostname = n.h;

-- Behind the human actor (jdoe)'s identifiers, count DISTINCT physical assets
-- after collapsing hostname/ip/instance-id aliases.
WITH jdoe(i) AS (
  VALUES ('jdoe@acme.example'),
         ('arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/jdoe'),
         ('arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/AdminRole/jdoe-session')
),
-- every host/ip identifier appearing in jdoe's events across all actor-bearing tables
refs AS (
  SELECT target_host AS id FROM f_auth    WHERE user_uid       IN (SELECT i FROM jdoe) AND target_host     IS NOT NULL
  UNION SELECT src_ip          FROM f_auth    WHERE user_uid       IN (SELECT i FROM jdoe) AND src_ip          IS NOT NULL
  UNION SELECT host            FROM f_session WHERE user_uid       IN (SELECT i FROM jdoe) AND host            IS NOT NULL
  UNION SELECT device_hostname FROM f_process WHERE actor_user_uid IN (SELECT i FROM jdoe) AND device_hostname IS NOT NULL
  UNION SELECT src_ip          FROM f_api     WHERE actor_user_uid IN (SELECT i FROM jdoe) AND src_ip          IS NOT NULL
),
-- alias edges: f_asset triples (hostname/ip/instance) + ip<->hostname observations from net/dns
edge(x, y) AS (
  SELECT hostname, ip           FROM f_asset
  UNION ALL SELECT hostname, instance_uid FROM f_asset
  UNION ALL SELECT ip,       instance_uid FROM f_asset
  UNION ALL SELECT src_ip,   src_hostname FROM f_network WHERE src_hostname IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT src_ip,   src_hostname FROM f_dns     WHERE src_hostname IS NOT NULL
),
-- canonical physical-asset key = the f_asset IP each identifier belongs to
-- (shared IP collapses WS1/WS2; net/dns resolves the auth src_ip back to its WS host)
to_phys(id, phys) AS (
  SELECT r.id,
    COALESCE(
      (SELECT a.ip FROM f_asset a WHERE a.hostname     = r.id LIMIT 1),
      (SELECT a.ip FROM f_asset a WHERE a.instance_uid = r.id LIMIT 1),
      CASE WHEN r.id IN (SELECT ip FROM f_asset) THEN r.id END,
      (SELECT a.ip FROM f_asset a
         WHERE a.hostname IN (SELECT e.y FROM edge e WHERE e.x = r.id)
            OR a.ip       IN (SELECT e.x FROM edge e WHERE e.y = r.id) LIMIT 1)
    )
  FROM refs r
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT phys) AS distinct_physical_assets
FROM to_phys
WHERE phys IS NOT NULL;  -- exclude pure-external IPs (e.g. 203.0.113.7 API origin, not a fleet asset)

-- Human actor = jdoe. Identifiers tied to jdoe across the store:
--   email  jdoe@acme.example
--   IAM    arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/jdoe
--   STS    arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/AdminRole/jdoe-session
--   SID    S-1-5-21-3623811015-3361044348-30300820-1107  (the only actor whose
--          process activity is confined to a single workstation; every other SID
--          sprays across 40+ host aliases, i.e. synthetic noise)
-- Plus jdoe's two external source IPs (10.10.1.21, 203.0.113.7) round out the six
-- identifiers, but those are VPN/source IPs, not members of the 12-asset population.
-- Collapse hostname/ip/instance-id aliases via f_asset (true alias key = shared IP,
-- since canonical_asset is NOT pre-collapsed per the v2 schema note) and count.
WITH jdoe_ids(id) AS (
  VALUES
    ('jdoe@acme.example'),
    ('arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/jdoe'),
    ('arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/AdminRole/jdoe-session'),
    ('S-1-5-21-3623811015-3361044348-30300820-1107')
),
locs AS (
  SELECT target_host AS loc FROM f_auth    WHERE user_uid       IN (SELECT id FROM jdoe_ids)
  UNION ALL SELECT src_ip          FROM f_auth    WHERE user_uid       IN (SELECT id FROM jdoe_ids)
  UNION ALL SELECT host            FROM f_session WHERE user_uid       IN (SELECT id FROM jdoe_ids)
  UNION ALL SELECT device_hostname FROM f_process WHERE actor_user_uid IN (SELECT id FROM jdoe_ids)
  UNION ALL SELECT src_ip          FROM f_api     WHERE actor_user_uid IN (SELECT id FROM jdoe_ids)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.ip) AS distinct_physical_assets
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT loc FROM locs) l
JOIN f_asset a
  ON l.loc = a.hostname OR l.loc = a.ip OR l.loc = a.instance_uid;

-- Human actor = jdoe, who presents under six identifiers across the store:
--   email jdoe@acme.example; IAM ARN arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/jdoe;
--   STS ARN arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/AdminRole/jdoe-session;
--   Windows SID S-1-5-21-...-1107 (the only SID active on his interactive host);
--   plus his two source IPs 10.10.1.21 (corp) and 203.0.113.7 (cloud egress).
-- "Physical assets" are the targets/devices he operates ON, collapsed via f_asset,
-- where hostname/instance-id aliases that share an IP are one machine.
WITH actor_ids(id) AS (
  VALUES
    ('jdoe@acme.example'),
    ('arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/jdoe'),
    ('arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/AdminRole/jdoe-session'),
    ('S-1-5-21-3623811015-3361044348-30300820-1107')
),
touched_hosts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT target_host AS hostname
    FROM f_auth WHERE user_uid IN (SELECT id FROM actor_ids) AND target_host IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT host
    FROM f_session WHERE user_uid IN (SELECT id FROM actor_ids) AND host IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname
    FROM f_process WHERE actor_user_uid IN (SELECT id FROM actor_ids) AND device_hostname IS NOT NULL
),
-- Collapse hostname/ip/instance-id aliases: rows of f_asset sharing an IP are one physical asset.
resolved AS (
  SELECT a.ip AS physical_asset_key
  FROM touched_hosts t
  JOIN f_asset a ON a.hostname = t.hostname
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT physical_asset_key) AS distinct_physical_assets
FROM resolved;

WITH RECURSIVE
-- (1) the human actor jdoe's cross-source identifiers (email, IAM ARN, STS assumed-role ARN, Windows SID)
jdoe_ids(id) AS (
  VALUES ('jdoe@acme.example'),
         ('arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/jdoe'),
         ('arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/AdminRole/jdoe-session'),
         ('S-1-5-21-3623811015-3361044348-30300820-1107')
),
-- (2) every hostname/ip/instance-id reference appearing in jdoe's events across the six tables
jdoe_assets(ref) AS (
  SELECT target_host     FROM f_auth    WHERE user_uid       IN (SELECT id FROM jdoe_ids)
  UNION SELECT src_ip          FROM f_auth    WHERE user_uid       IN (SELECT id FROM jdoe_ids)
  UNION SELECT host            FROM f_session WHERE user_uid       IN (SELECT id FROM jdoe_ids)
  UNION SELECT device_hostname FROM f_process WHERE actor_user_uid IN (SELECT id FROM jdoe_ids)
  UNION SELECT src_ip          FROM f_api     WHERE actor_user_uid IN (SELECT id FROM jdoe_ids)
),
-- (3) collapse f_asset aliases into physical assets: two rows are the same box if they share ANY of hostname/ip/instance_uid (transitive closure)
edges AS (
  SELECT a.hostname AS u, b.hostname AS v
  FROM f_asset a JOIN f_asset b
    ON a.hostname = b.hostname OR a.ip = b.ip OR a.instance_uid = b.instance_uid
),
cc(node, rep) AS (
  SELECT hostname, hostname FROM f_asset
  UNION
  SELECT e.v, c.rep FROM cc c JOIN edges e ON e.u = c.node
),
comp AS (SELECT node AS hostname, MIN(rep) AS phys FROM cc GROUP BY node),
-- (4) resolve each jdoe asset-reference (by hostname OR ip OR instance) to its collapsed physical asset
resolved AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cm.phys
  FROM jdoe_assets j
  JOIN f_asset fa ON j.ref = fa.hostname OR j.ref = fa.ip OR j.ref = fa.instance_uid
  JOIN comp cm ON cm.hostname = fa.hostname
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_physical_assets FROM resolved;

WITH RECURSIVE
ids AS (
  -- the human actor's identifier values present in the store (jdoe across SID / IAM / STS / email)
  SELECT unnest([
    'S-1-5-21-3623811015-3361044348-30300820-1107',
    'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/jdoe',
    'arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/AdminRole/jdoe-session',
    'jdoe@acme.example'
  ]) AS uid
),
-- every asset-identifying signal the actor's events expose (hostnames + ips)
sig AS (
  SELECT target_host AS host, src_ip AS ip FROM f_auth    WHERE user_uid       IN (SELECT uid FROM ids)
  UNION ALL SELECT host,           NULL   FROM f_session  WHERE user_uid       IN (SELECT uid FROM ids)
  UNION ALL SELECT device_hostname, NULL  FROM f_process  WHERE actor_user_uid IN (SELECT uid FROM ids)
  UNION ALL SELECT NULL,           src_ip FROM f_api      WHERE actor_user_uid IN (SELECT uid FROM ids)
),
-- resolve each signal to an f_asset row by hostname or ip (external client IPs match nothing)
hit AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.hostname AS anchor
  FROM sig s JOIN f_asset a ON a.hostname = s.host OR a.ip = s.ip
),
-- collapse hostname/ip/instance-id aliases into physical assets (connected components)
edges AS (
  SELECT a.hostname AS u, b.hostname AS v
  FROM f_asset a JOIN f_asset b
    ON (a.ip = b.ip OR a.instance_uid = b.instance_uid OR a.hostname = b.hostname)
),
cc(n, lbl) AS (
  SELECT hostname, hostname FROM f_asset
  UNION
  SELECT e.v, c.lbl FROM cc c JOIN edges e ON e.u = c.n
),
comp AS (SELECT n, MIN(lbl) AS comp_id FROM cc GROUP BY n)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT comp.comp_id) AS distinct_physical_assets
FROM hit JOIN comp ON comp.n = hit.anchor;
